labels.measured: Observed directly at this field (ground instrument, or satellite pixels inside the field).
labels.validated: Derived or modelled, and checked against independent ground truth; test result recorded.
labels.modelled: From a model or prediction not checked at this field.
labels.assumed: From literature or an expert rule; not tested here.

evidence.label: validated
evidence.claim: Daily rainfall at the field, from NASA POWER, corrected month by month to match local stations.
evidence.source: NASA POWER (PRECTOTCORR), corrected against ECCC Fergus Shand Dam (4760)
evidence.test: Correction fitted on 1996-2010, tested on 2011-2025 (years it never saw)
evidence.result: Held-out error after correction: -4.7% of station rainfall
evidence.caveat: ~50 km grid: single storms are missed; good for seasons, not days. Elora RCS (ECCC 41983) reads -12% vs Fergus over 2011-2025

evidence.label: validated
evidence.claim: Daily air temperature at the field (frost dates, heat units), corrected to the Elora station.
evidence.source: NASA POWER (T2M, T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX), corrected against ECCC Elora RCS (41983)
evidence.result: Night-time bias +1.0 -> +0.1 degC; frost-free days error +11 -> +4 days
evidence.caveat: Fixes the average lean, not single nights: one unusual cold night can still be missed.

evidence.label: modelled
evidence.claim: Topsoil (0-30 cm) texture, organic carbon, pH and bulk density, each with a 90% range.
evidence.caveat: A prediction, not a sample. The organic-carbon range is very wide here; a lab soil test should replace it.

evidence.label: modelled
evidence.claim: Typical root-zone soil wetness by month.
evidence.source: NASA SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP v8) via AppEEARS, 9 km
evidence.caveat: One value for a 9 km square: shows wet and dry YEARS well, not wet and dry spots in a field.

evidence.label: measured
evidence.claim: Greenness (NDVI) of each field on every clear satellite pass since 2015.
evidence.source: NASA HLS v2.0, Landsat 8/9 (L30) + Sentinel-2 (S30), 30 m
evidence.caveat: Clouds and snow leave gaps; gaps longer than 30 days are left empty, never filled in.

evidence.label: validated
evidence.claim: Which crop grew each year (winter wheat vs corn/soybean) and whether there was green cover off-season.
evidence.source: Derived from NASA HLS greenness timing (fieldsense.phenology)
evidence.test: Compared with partner field records, Elora rotation plots, 2015-2021
evidence.result: winter wheat found in 2 of 2 wheat plot-years; corn/soybean labelled correctly in 26 of 26
evidence.caveat: Thresholds were tuned at this site, and wheat cases are few; corn and soybean are not separated.

evidence.label: assumed
evidence.claim: Thresholds that turn weather into risks (e.g. 32 degC at corn pollination, 25 mm heavy rain).
evidence.source: Agronomic rules of thumb in fieldsense.climate.RISKS
evidence.caveat: To be checked against OMAFRA guidance; change a threshold and the odds change.

evidence.label: modelled
evidence.claim: Soil cover for rotations, estimated from a crop calendar (fieldsense/data/crops.json).
evidence.caveat: Differs from satellite measurement by up to 24 points (CSS green share season: -10 pts; CSS green share off season: -3 pts; CSS spring bare share: -1 pts; SWC+covers green share season: +2 pts; SWC+covers green share off season: +11 pts; SWC+covers spring bare share: -24 pts).

evidence.label: validated
evidence.claim: Which crop grew each year on nearby farm fields (winter wheat vs corn/soybean), read from NASA HLS greenness.
evidence.source: NASA HLS greenness timing (fieldsense.phenology), rules from the Elora trial
evidence.test: Compared with AAFC Annual Crop Inventory on 6 farm fields near Elora, 2015-2025
evidence.result: winter wheat found in 8 of 8 wheat field-years; corn/soybean labelled correctly in 53 of 58; 5 false wheat labels
evidence.caveat: The crop map targets at least 85% accuracy and does not record cover crops; the fields were chosen from the same map.
